name: Jackrabbit
description: Enrollment, recurring tuition, attendance, and a parent portal for dance, gymnastics, swim, and cheer studios. Huntersville, North Carolina. Founded 2004.

mentions.evidence: The company says it serves more than 17,000 schools in 35 countries. It was named a Charlotte Business Journal 2025 Fast 50 winner, ranked on three years of revenue growth that an accounting firm checked. That award is a growth badge, not a revenue total. LeadIQ estimates about $15 million a year as of July 2025, with about 120 employees. The company has not published revenue.
mentions.indieAngle: Twenty years of the same monthly bill, for a kids' activity. Martial arts, music, and tutoring are the thinner versions.

whyItPrints: Every studio has the same monthly tuition headache. Once the parent's card is stored, the studio does not switch.
whyThisMatters: A dance studio charges tuition every month, and the parent's card is the product.
